editionLabel: dV Giochi English rules, fourth edition
firstPlayerRule: Roles are dealt at random and the Sheriff reveals their role card. The Sheriff begins.
clarifications: Play proceeds in turns in clockwise order from the Sheriff.
The Sheriff plays with one extra bullet (life point) beyond their character card.
